name: openbmb/minicpm-v
title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 1B runs local camera scene understanding
summary: OpenBMB showed CamThink using MiniCPM-V 4.7 1B on site as a local vision model that turns camera snapshots into structured results such as people counts, safety violations, meter readings, and bin-fill levels. Inference stays on the site network, and outputs are checked against a schema before they are stored as metrics.
